{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor trips''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] programmed to trigger another system when activated. Sensor trips could be connected to a variety of other mechanisms, such as [[Mine/Legends|mines]] or alarms. Specific types of sensor trips included [[heat trip]]s, [[motion trip]]s, [[pressure trip]]s, and [[repulsorfield trip]]s.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
